english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for hitting someone or something forcefully and repeatedly.
Use this as the default for striking something hard and repeatedly.

examples.english: They used a stick to batter the gate.
examples.jyutping: keoi5 lo4 zyu6 zi1 gwan3 maang5 daa2 dou6 zaap6

examples.english: They use a hammer to pound the wooden board.
examples.jyutping: keoi5 jung6 ceoi4 zai2 maang5 daa2 faai3 muk6 baan2
